title: July-start fiscal years
brief: Assign reporting years that start midway through a calendar year.
instructions: Return every order and the fiscal ending year. July 2024 through June 2025 belongs to fiscal 2025. Use UTC month and year.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes order_id,ordered_at from orders without solving july-start fiscal years.

hints.text: A July-start fiscal year is labeled by its ending year.
Add one to the UTC calendar year for months July through December.
June belongs to the current year; UTC December belongs to the following fiscal year.
